item.description: The lecture explains the divine nature of Krishna’s appearance and activities. item.title: Vrindavan, Vrindavan, Vrindavan
item.description: By Srila Prabodhananda Sarasvati Thakura Vrindavan is wonderful. The two sweet fair and dark splendors named Radha and Krsna are wonderful. Pure love for Their lotus feet is wonderful. He who has faith in Them and rises to the spiritual world is wonderful. The rare soul who understands these truths is wonderful. item.title: The Antiquity of Deity Worship in the Vedic Tradition
item.description: By Sri Nandanandana dasa There have been some people who have declared that the worship of Deities or images or the murti in the temples is but a recent invention of Vedic culture.
